description: Does this business run trucks, and is it allowed to? Returns its FMCSA motor carriers (USDOT numbers with a Texas physical address): status, interstate or intrastate operation, for-hire or private classification, power units, drivers, hazmat, MCS-150 date, safety rating, operating authority (MC docket), out-of-service orders (in force until rescinded) and crashes in the last 24 months, each with a SAFER link to verify. Give an entity_id, or a dot_number to look up a carrier directly. The census carries no Texas taxpayer number: by entity, carriers with the same name and street address are returned in full, and name-only matches are listed in possible_carriers without their orders or crashes. Crash reports are not a finding of fault. An empty list does not mean the business runs no trucks. Refreshed daily from FMCSA. Requires a signed-in caller (token or OAuth). Example: {"entity_id": "17507442626"} or {"dot_number": "79355"}.

dot_number.description: USDOT number, e.g. "79355". Used instead of entity_id.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.
